articles.title: Anthropic Releases Claude 4 with Extended Reasoning and 1M Token Context
articles.summary: Anthropic has unveiled Claude 4, its most capable model to date, featuring a native one-million token context window and significantly improved multi-step reasoning capabilities. The model outperforms competitors on multiple benchmarks including MMLU, HumanEval, and a new long-context retrieval suite. Claude 4 is available via API and Anthropic's consumer products starting today.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's AlphaFold 4 Predicts RNA and DNA Structures with Unprecedented Accuracy
articles.summary: Google DeepMind announced AlphaFold 4, expanding beyond protein folding to accurately model RNA and DNA tertiary structures. Researchers say the tool could dramatically accelerate drug discovery for genetic diseases and viral pathogens. The model is being made available to academic institutions through a new partnership with the Wellcome Trust.

articles.title: OpenAI Launches Operator Pro: Autonomous Agent Platform for Enterprise Workflows
articles.summary: OpenAI has expanded its Operator product with a new enterprise-tier called Operator Pro, enabling businesses to deploy fully autonomous AI agents across complex multi-system workflows. The platform integrates with Salesforce, SAP, and Microsoft 365, allowing agents to execute tasks spanning CRM updates, financial reporting, and supply chain management. Early customers report up to 40% reduction in operational overhead during beta testing.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Body Issues First Major Fine Against Unnamed LLM Provider
articles.summary: The newly established EU AI Office has issued its first significant enforcement action under the AI Act, levying a €48 million fine against an unnamed large language model provider for failing to meet transparency and bias documentation requirements. The case centers on inadequate disclosure of training data sources and missing conformity assessments for high-risk deployment categories. Legal analysts say the action signals aggressive enforcement ahead of the Act's full compliance deadline later this year.

articles.title: Meta Introduces Joint Embedding Architecture for Real-Time Video Understanding
articles.summary: Meta AI Research has published a paper and accompanying open-source model capable of real-time semantic understanding of video streams using a novel joint embedding architecture. The system processes video at 30fps on consumer-grade GPUs while simultaneously generating natural language descriptions and answering queries about ongoing footage. The work represents a major step forward for applications in robotics, accessibility tools, and live content moderation.

articles.title: Microsoft Azure Unveils RAG 2.0 Toolkit with Adaptive Chunking and Source Verification
articles.summary: Microsoft has released a major update to its Azure AI Search and retrieval-augmented generation stack, branding it RAG 2.0, with features including adaptive semantic chunking, automatic source credibility scoring, and hallucination-detection guardrails. The toolkit is designed to help enterprises build more reliable knowledge-grounded applications without requiring custom model fine-tuning. The release is accompanied by a benchmark showing a 31% reduction in factual errors compared to standard RAG pipelines.

articles.title: Stanford HAI Report Warns of Accelerating AI-Enabled Disinformation at Scale
articles.summary: Stanford's Human-Centered AI Institute released its annual AI Index report with a dedicated chapter on AI-generated disinformation, finding a 340% year-over-year increase in detected synthetic media campaigns targeting electoral processes globally. Researchers highlight that current platform detection tools lag significantly behind generation capabilities, creating a widening safety gap. The report calls for mandatory watermarking standards and coordinated international regulation.

articles.title: Mistral AI Open-Sources Mistral-Next-72B Beating GPT-4o on Several Coding Benchmarks
articles.summary: Paris-based Mistral AI has released Mistral-Next-72B as a fully open-weight model under the Apache 2.0 license, posting top scores on HumanEval+, SWE-bench, and LiveCodeBench that surpass OpenAI's GPT-4o. The model uses a new mixture-of-depths architecture that dynamically allocates compute per token, achieving strong performance with lower inference costs. The release is being celebrated by the open-source AI community as a landmark moment for accessible frontier-class models.
